finding: BuildingOperationStep claimed nearest reserve selection but evaluated promotion in roster order. An earlier farther candidate could spend the sole callback cover VIEW ray before a nearer established observer was evaluated.
implementation: Rank the existing rotating maximum16 candidate window by distance to survivor/building and stable window index before calling promotion; first candidate with actual promotion proof wins.
authority: Existing sole-exit-cover protection, one shared VIEW ray, current proof revalidation, native actor tasks, exact episode and original deadline unchanged.
cost: Sort at most16 tuples per casualty slot; no new query or worker. Runtime not measured.
limits: Nearest within current rotating window and available proof budget only; no shortest-route or physical arrival guarantee. Source intent is continuity of the surviving CQB pair, not copying unbounded upstream pair workers.
validation: Existing promotion tests extended; full build and independent candidate results recorded in handover.

proofFairnessFollowup.finding: Strict nearest-first retries can starve farther promotable posts when the nearest candidate repeatedly spends the single ray on blocked coverage. This supersedes the previous strict distance-priority description.
proofFairnessFollowup.implementation: Per casualty-slot private cursor stores only the identity of a candidate that actually spent the ray. The next callback rotates the currently distance-ranked bounded window after that identity, wrapping naturally. Success deletes the cursor. Equal-distance ties use stable netId, not rotating window index.
proofFairnessFollowup.bounds: At most one identity per existing lane slot, no extra query, timer, worker, retry or deadline. Cursor is proposal fairness only, not authority or coverage evidence.
proofFairnessFollowup.limits: Fixed candidate set gets round-robin probe opportunity; moving actors, larger rotating windows and physical flow remain unverified. Cursor may reset on owner adoption without renewing operation time.
proofFairnessFollowup.validation: Existing promotion regression extended with blocked-near/tie/far sequence; full build result in handover.
